## `run_dbscan_model`

```python
run_dbscan_model(
    rad: str,
    start: dt.datetime,
    end: dt.datetime,
    *,
    files: Sequence[str | os.PathLike] | None = None,
    root: str | os.PathLike | None = None,
    ftype: str = 'fitacf',
    params: Dbscan | None = None,
    geometry: str = 'legacy',
    altitude: float = 300.0,
    out_base: str | os.PathLike = 'data/outputs',
    sim_id: str = 'L101',
    write_netcdf: bool = True,
    write_fitacf: bool = True,
    extra_fields: bool = False,
    input_paths: Sequence[str | os.PathLike] | None = None,
    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> dict
```

Run the DBSCAN / GMM model for one radar and time window.

Reads the scans in ``[start, end]``, labels every echo with ``cluster_tag`` and ``gflg_ribiero``
([`cluster_scans`](clustering.md#cluster_scans)) and writes ``<rad>_<start>_<end>.pp.nc`` and
``<YYYYMMDD.HHMM.SS>.<rad>.fitacf.pp.bz2`` plus ``params.toml`` / ``script.cmd`` to ``<out_base>/<sim_id>/<rad>/``.
The echoes themselves are the raw fitacf echoes; the ``.fitacf.pp.bz2`` keeps every original record.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rad` | str | required | Three-letter radar code (``"bks"``). |
| `start`, `end` | datetime | required | Time window (UTC, naive); all scans inside it are labelled. |
| `files` | sequence of path, optional | `None` | Explicit fitacf files (not directories; expand them with [`expand_paths`](io.md#expand_paths)). When ``None`` the files are looked up under ``root``. |
| `root` | path, optional | `None` | Archive root (default ``$AMGEO_SD_DATA``). |
| `ftype` | str | `'fitacf'` | ``"fitacf"`` or ``"fitacf3"``; used for the archive lookup and in messages. |
| `params` | Dbscan, optional | `None` | Clustering parameters (`[dbscan]` table of the [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md)); the defaults when ``None``. |
| `geometry` | ``"legacy"`` or ``"pydarn"`` | `'legacy'` | Field-of-view implementation stored in the NetCDF file, see [`radar_fov`](geo.md#radar_fov). |
| `altitude` | float | `300.0` | Cell height [km] of the geolocation. |
| `out_base` | path | `'data/outputs'` | Output base directory; results go to ``<out_base>/<sim_id>/<rad>/``. |
| `sim_id` | str | `'L101'` | Name of the run, the second directory level. |
| `write_netcdf` | bool | `True` | Write ``<rad>_<start>_<end>.pp.nc``. |
| `write_fitacf` | bool | `True` | Write ``<YYYYMMDD.HHMM.SS>.<rad>.fitacf.pp.bz2``. |
| `extra_fields` | bool | `False` | Store the non-standard fields (``cluster_tag``, ``gflg_ribiero``, ``amgeo.model``, ``amgeo.version``) in that file. Off by default, which leaves the raw records unchanged so that ``pydarnio.read_fitacf`` and other fitacf readers can open it; the ``.pp.nc`` always has them. |
| `input_paths` | sequence of path, optional | `None` | What to record as ``[input] paths`` in ``params.toml``. |
| `argv` | sequence of str, optional | `None` | Command line recorded in the output; ``sys.argv`` when ``None``. |

**Returns**

- *dict* — ``scan_info``, ``n_scans``, ``n_echoes``, ``n_clusters`` (beam, label pairs without noise), ``fraction_ground`` / ``fraction_noise`` of the echoes, ``out_dir``, ``nc_file`` / ``fitacf_file`` (when written) and ``scans``.

**Raises**

- *RuntimeError* — When there is no data at ``start`` or no scan with echoes in the time range.

## `run_median_filter`

```python
run_median_filter(
    rad: str,
    start: dt.datetime,
    end: dt.datetime,
    *,
    files: Sequence[str | os.PathLike] | None = None,
    root: str | os.PathLike | None = None,
    ftype: str = 'fitacf',
    thresh: float = 0.6,
    pth: float = 0.25,
    lth: float = 0.2,
    uth: float = 0.8,
    kde: bool = True,
    cluster: bool = True,
    eps: float = 2,
    min_samples: int = 5,
    n_jobs: int = 1,
    out_base: str | os.PathLike = 'data/outputs',
    sim_id: str = 'L100',
    save: bool = True,
    write_netcdf: bool = True,
    write_fitacf: bool = True,
    extra_fields: bool = False,
    input_paths: Sequence[str | os.PathLike] | None = None,
    geometry: str = 'legacy',
    altitude: float = 300.0,
    edge_gates: str = 'legacy',
    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> dict
```

Run the median-filter model for one radar and time window.

Input is either ``files`` or the archive ``root`` (default ``$AMGEO_SD_DATA``); ``input_paths`` only
changes what is recorded in ``params.toml`` (the directories the files were expanded from). Scans whose start
lies in ``[start, end]`` are filtered; the neighbouring scans needed by the 3-scan window are read
from just outside it. See [`MedianFilter`](filters.md#medianfilter) for the algorithm. Every filter parameter has
the meaning and allowed values given in the [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md) (`[median]` table).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rad` | str | required | Three-letter radar code (``"bks"``). |
| `start`, `end` | datetime | required | Time window (UTC, naive). Scans starting inside it are written. |
| `files` | sequence of path, optional | `None` | Explicit fitacf files (not directories; expand them with [`expand_paths`](io.md#expand_paths)). When ``None`` the files are looked up under ``root``. |
| `root` | path, optional | `None` | Archive root (default ``$AMGEO_SD_DATA``) with the layout ``<year>/<ftype>/<rad>/<YYYYMMDD>.*``. |
| `ftype` | str | `'fitacf'` | ``"fitacf"`` or ``"fitacf3"``; used for the archive lookup and in messages. |
| `thresh` | float | `0.6` | Share of the neighbour weight that must hold an echo for a cell to survive, 0 to 1. |
| `pth` | float | `0.25` | Beta-distribution cut of ``gflg_kde``. |
| `lth`, `uth` | float | `0.2` / `0.8` | Lower and upper probability bounds of ``gflg_conv`` / ``gflg_kde``: at or below ``lth`` ionospheric, at or above ``uth`` ground, between them undetermined (2). |
| `kde` | bool | `True` | Compute ``gflg_kde`` (slow; NaN when ``False``). |
| `cluster` | bool | `True` | Compute the per-scan DBSCAN label ``clabel``. |
| `eps`, `min_samples` | float, int | `2` / `5` | DBSCAN radius and minimum size of ``clabel``. |
| `n_jobs` | int | `1` | Worker processes of the filter (needs an ``if __name__ == "__main__":`` guard in the calling script when > 1). |
| `out_base` | path | `'data/outputs'` | Output base directory; results go to ``<out_base>/<sim_id>/<rad>/``. |
| `sim_id` | str | `'L100'` | Name of the run, the second directory level. |
| `save` | bool | `True` | Write files. ``False`` only returns the filtered scans. |
| `write_netcdf` | bool | `True` | Write ``<rad>_<start>_<end>.pp.nc`` (only when ``save``). |
| `write_fitacf` | bool | `True` | Write ``<YYYYMMDD.HHMM.SS>.<rad>.fitacf.pp.bz2`` (only when ``save``). |
| `extra_fields` | bool | `False` | Store the non-standard fields (``v_mad``, ``gflg_conv``, ``gflg_kde``, ``clabel``, ``amgeo.model``, ...) in that file. Off by default so that ``pydarnio.read_fitacf`` and other fitacf readers can open it; the ``.pp.nc`` always has them. |
| `input_paths` | sequence of path, optional | `None` | What to record as ``[input] paths`` in ``params.toml`` (e.g. the directories ``files`` came from). |
| `geometry` | ``"legacy"`` or ``"pydarn"`` | `'legacy'` | Field-of-view implementation stored in the NetCDF file, see [`radar_fov`](geo.md#radar_fov). |
| `altitude` | float | `300.0` | Cell height [km] of the geolocation. |
| `edge_gates` | ``"legacy"`` or ``"missing"`` | `'legacy'` | How out-of-range gates count as neighbours, see [`MedianFilter`](filters.md#medianfilter). |
| `argv` | sequence of str, optional | `None` | Command line recorded in ``script.cmd`` / ``params.toml``; ``sys.argv`` when ``None``. |

**Returns**

- *dict* — ``scan_info``, ``n_scans``, ``n_echoes``, ``scans`` (the filtered [`Scan`](models.md#scan) list) and, when ``save``, ``out_dir`` plus ``nc_file`` and ``fitacf_file`` (the files written).

**Raises**

- *RuntimeError* — When there is no data at ``start``, fewer than three scans, or (with ``save``) nothing survives the filter.

**Examples**

```python
out = run_median_filter("bks", datetime(2025, 2, 8, 3), datetime(2025, 2, 8, 4), files=files, kde=False)
out["nc_file"]
'data/outputs/L100/bks/bks_202502080300_202502080400.pp.nc'
```

## `run_plot`

```python
run_plot(kind: str, settings: Settings) -> str
```

Draw one figure and return its path.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | ``"rti"`` or ``"fov"`` | required | RTI of ``plot.beam`` (``plot.params`` panels; with ``plot.compare`` the same beam from several files stacked), or a map of the scan nearest ``plot.time`` (one map per ``plot.params`` entry). |
| `settings` | Settings | required | Uses the ``[plot]`` table (inputs, beam, params, time, coords, ...) and ``[geometry]``; every key is in the [parameter reference](../PARAMETERS.md). |

**Returns**

- *str* — Path of the figure written, ``<plot.out>/<name>.<plot.format>``.

**Raises**

- *ValueError* — For an unknown ``kind``, or when the radar code cannot be determined.
- *RuntimeError* — When the inputs hold no echoes in the time range.
